params.columns: k UInt64, a UInt64, b UInt64, c UInt64, d UInt64
params.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number + {i} * {rows} AS k, sipHash64(k, {seed}) AS a, a % 1000 AS b, k * 7 AS c, intDiv(k, 3) AS d FROM numbers({rows})

description: Validation of the natural-merge rules on every remote variant: the merge-natural.default workload (64 inserts of 100 000 rows, 5 UInt64 columns) with a new seed, then a wait until no merge has run for 60 s.
